title: Thirty search results reduced traffic and revenue

change.variant: Thirty results per page, also increasing generation time by about half a second.

quote: Traffic and revenue from Google searchers in the experimental group dropped by 20%.
notes: Marissa Mayer example discussed in this paper. More results and speed changed together; authors dispute attributing the full loss to latency alone. Full text is also available in the author-hosted PDF at https://exp-platform.com/Documents/2014%20experimentersRulesOfThumb.pdf. The supporting quote and result were checked against that PDF; the equivalent ACM publisher full-text page returned HTTP 403 in Chromium.
